column1: # C the PC port builds for functions whose matching source (in matched.tsv) can't give a native build
# the function: hand-written assembly (the .s stays the matching source; this C is not byte-exact by
# design), and compiler-generated C++ code a native C++ compiler doesn't emit the same way. Without a
# row here the port would run the translated retail MIPS.
# verify: a test in platform/pc/tests/ (against the retail code), or a matcher (cc/sym/div, as in
# matched.tsv: byte-exact; node tools/check_all.mjs re-verifies those rows too)
